name: Firing Line
hint: Two takes. The turret at the right end sweeps the floor from x=22 to its muzzle every 1.1s, which is far too dense to walk through — but switch s1 at x=13 takes it offline for 5 seconds, and plate p1 at x=5 opens the door at x=24. You cannot hold the plate and press the switch and run, so one of the three has to be recorded. TAKE 1: walk right onto p1 (x=5..7.2) and stand there. The door opens while you stand, but it is 19 units away and shuts 0.35s after you step off. End the take on the plate. TAKE 2: Echo A holds p1 from about t=0.6s, so the door is open before you need it. Run right to switch s1 at x=13..14, press USE at about t=1.5s — the turret goes dark for 5s — then keep running: the doorway at x=24 is 11 units on (1.2s), the exit at x=34 is 10 further (1.1s), so you arrive around t=4.1s with most of a second to spare. Do not stop to think inside the lane. Worth knowing for later rooms: a bullet that hits an Echo dies on it, so an Echo standing in a firing lane is cover — here both of your bodies are busy, but it is a real tactic.

dialogue.text: It does not aim. It just keeps the corridor full.

dialogue.speaker: ECHO-0
dialogue.text: Five seconds of quiet is all the switch buys. Spend them running.
